title: Route commands by registered checkout
when: A machine uses hosted and self-hosted universes whose numeric project IDs overlap.
need: Register each checkout on its connection using --env. Later commands there select that connection automatically; nested registrations choose the deepest root. Outside registered checkouts, unique project references select their connection, then active_env supplies the fallback. Ambiguous checkout registration refuses by name; use --env or project register --reassign to remove duplicate registration.
surface: Project register help, work-claim folder refusal and public machine-config guidance.
review: Source regression tests cover precedence, admin pairing, nested roots, duplicate refusal and reference routing. No live multi-universe execution is claimed.
